drivers.name: Lewis Hamilton
drivers.biography: Considered one of the greatest drivers of all time, Lewis Hamilton is known for his exceptional skill and social activism.

drivers.name: Michael Schumacher
drivers.biography: An absolute F1 legend, Michael Schumacher dominated the 2000s with Ferrari and redefined what it meant to be a champion.

drivers.name: Ayrton Senna
drivers.biography: A Brazilian idol and regarded as the best rain driver of all time, Senna made history in the 80s and 90s.

drivers.name: Alain Prost
drivers.biography: Known as 'The Professor', Prost was famous for his tactical intelligence and epic rivalry with Senna.

drivers.name: Juan Manuel Fangio
drivers.biography: A legend from the early days of F1, Fangio dominated the 1950s and set the standard for future champions.

drivers.name: Max Verstappen
drivers.biography: Current world champion, Verstappen represents the new generation of highly skilled drivers.

drivers.name: Fernando Alonso
drivers.biography: Two-time world champion known for extracting maximum performance from less competitive cars.

drivers.name: Niki Lauda
drivers.biography: Famous for his determination and comeback after the horrific 1976 crash at Nürburgring.

drivers.name: Sebastian Vettel
drivers.biography: Four-time consecutive champion from 2010–2013, known for his precision and technical knowledge.

drivers.name: Jackie Stewart
drivers.biography: Safety pioneer in F1 and three-time world champion in the 60s and 70s.

drivers.name: Jim Clark
drivers.biography: Dominant in the 1960s with exceptional skill.

drivers.name: Nelson Piquet
drivers.biography: Known for his technical expertise and three titles.

drivers.name: Graham Hill
drivers.biography: Versatile driver with wins in F1, Indy 500, and Le Mans.

teams.name: Ferrari
teams.description: The most historic and iconic team in Formula 1, based in Maranello, Italy.

teams.name: Mercedes
teams.description: Dominant in the hybrid era, Mercedes set new standards of excellence.

teams.name: Red Bull Racing
teams.description: A young and aggressive team that won multiple titles with rising stars.

teams.name: McLaren
teams.description: One of the most traditional teams, home to legends like Senna and Prost.

teams.name: Williams
teams.description: Historic team that dominated the 80s and 90s with innovative technology.

races.name: Monaco Grand Prix
races.description: The most prestigious race on the calendar, through the streets of Monte Carlo.

races.name: Brazilian Grand Prix
races.description: Thrilling race in Ayrton Senna's home country, always unpredictable.

races.name: British Grand Prix
races.description: The home of motorsport and birthplace of Formula 1.

races.name: Italian Grand Prix
races.description: The temple of speed, with the unique atmosphere of the tifosi.

races.name: Singapore Grand Prix
races.description: F1's first night race, a unique visual spectacle.

techEvolutions.description: Introduction of V6 turbo hybrid engines with ERS system.
techEvolutions.impact: Revolutionized energy efficiency and technical complexity of the cars.

techEvolutions.description: New aerodynamic rules to improve racing.
techEvolutions.impact: Allowed for more overtaking and more exciting races.
Saved several lives and made F1 significantly safer.

techEvolutions.description: Introduction of carbon fiber brake discs.
Cars with ground effect for greater aerodynamic grip.
Movable rear wing to reduce drag and increase overtaking.
techEvolutions.impact: Enhanced race excitement by facilitating overtakes.

techEvolutions.description: System to recover energy under braking for a power boost.
techEvolutions.impact: Introduced energy recovery, precursor to hybrid systems.

techEvolutions.description: Paddle-shift gearbox for faster gear changes.
techEvolutions.impact: Improved shifting speed and driver focus.
Led to a power boom in the 1980s.

techEvolutions.description: Electronic system to prevent wheel spin.
techEvolutions.impact: Improved car stability, later banned for fairness.

techEvolutions.description: Engine placed behind the driver for better balance.
techEvolutions.impact: Became the standard design for F1 cars.

techEvolutions.description: Lightweight and strong carbon fiber chassis.
One tire manufacturer for all teams.
